'Cloaked / Instant - Destroy this: Prevent the next 1 damage that would be dealt to you this turn. Activate this ability only while this is face-down.'

Cloaked is a printed keyword and fires from the card DB, deliberately not authored.

'ONLY WHILE THIS IS FACE-DOWN' is an ability-level condition, which gates both the OFFER (play._add_hero_dsl_activations checks conditions before listing the action) and the resolution -- 'activate only if' means the action must not be offered at all. CARD_IS_FACE_DOWN reads the source card, and also treats is_public=False as face-down, because not every path that hides a card sets face_down.
